name: Zip-NeRF
definition: A model that integrates scale-aware anti-aliased NeRFs and fast grid-based NeRF training, leveraging multisampling and prefiltering to achieve lower error rates and faster training than prior techniques.
summary: Zip-NeRF is a fast, low-error neural radiance field method that replaces large MLPs with Instant-NGP grids and uses specific anti-aliasing mechanisms to handle high-frequency details and multiscale rendering.
